title: Inyenyeri zirondera ukudakeka
intro: Iyumvire ko uhagaze munsi y’ikirere kinini mw’ijoro, uriko urabona amatara yaka cane araduga hanyuma akazimangana mu gihe uriko urarondera ico vy’ukuri gikwiriye gusenga. Ikikuje wewe, ibishushanyo bibajwe bicereje birashimagizwa be n’amashikanwa, yamara imvo itomoye irakekeranya ububasha bwavyo. Ijwi ritagira ubwoba ririko rigira ngo rirwanye imigenzo twarazwe, ryerekeze ku Muremyi w’ijuru n’isi.
clues: Naravye inyenyeri, ukwezi n’izuba, nca niyumvira ko bidashobora kuba Umukama wanje kuko birenga bikabura.
Narahakanye ku mugaragaro ivyo abantu banje basenga uretse Allah, ndabahamagara ngo basenge Umuremyi wenyene.
Naciye ngira impaka n’umutware yirata yivugira ko ari we atanga ubuzima n’urupfu, nanje ndamwishura mu kuvuga Allah azana izuba rivuye mu buseruko.
Nakubise ibigirwamana ndabimenagura, nsigaza gusa ikinini kuruta ibindi vyose muri vyo kugira ngo abantu babisubireko.
Narafashwe ndacirwa urubanza n’abantu banje, bavuga ngo bubake inyubakwa, banjugunya mu muriro ururumba.
Narakijijwe igihe Allah yategeka umuriro ngo unbere ubukonje n’umutekano.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yarahanganye n’ugusenga ibigirwamana yongera araganira ku nsobanuro y’ibintu vyo mw’ijuru .

Yarongoye abayoboke biwe mu kiyaga cagabanijwe na Allah

trial.answer: Yarahanganye n’ugusenga ibigirwamana yongera araganira ku nsobanuro y’ibintu vyo mw’ijuru .

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]. (6:75)
